**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 22 is the only audit right binding us, and it satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

- **Frequency** — once in any twelve-month period (§ 22.1)
- **Notice** — thirty days' prior written notice (§ 22.1)
- **Manner** — normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1)
- **Cost** — Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2)
- **System access** — expressly prohibited, along with unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information (§ 22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further protections in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, shortfall payment closes the audited issue). Section 23 contains no reciprocal obligations to review. Nothing to redline.
